description: This file implements a KML parser for extracting GPS fixes from KML files, including functions for parsing coordinates, placemarks, and traversing the XML tree structure.

classes.name: KmlParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing KML files and strings to extract GPS fix data.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a KML file from the given file path and extracts GPS fixes into the provided array.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a KML document from a string buffer and extracts GPS fixes into the provided array.
